registry_server.description: Standalone read/write reviewer exception memory MCP for template-review agents and Dify external knowledge retrieval

dify_studio_steps: Create an HTTP MCP server card with server ID webflow-reviewer-exceptions.
Add the reviewer-exceptions external knowledge endpoint with knowledge_id reviewer-exceptions and bearer auth from Infisical prod:/webflow-reviewer-exceptions-mcp:DIFY_EXTERNAL_KNOWLEDGE_API_KEY.
Roll out through template-review Hub discovery first; do not add to app-review agents until the later app-agent rollout.
notes: This is a separate MCP, not part of webflow-app-review-mcp.
Template-review Hub discovery includes this server first; app-review rollout is intentionally deferred.
Agents can create, update, and delete exception records. Records become Dify-retrievable when Include in Dify Retrieval is true, Knowledge Status is Approved or Active, and the record is not expired.
Keep secret values in Infisical only; this artifact stores references, not values.
